evidence_excerpts: (1) The fact that Socrates is white makes <Socrates is white> true. (2) <Socrates is white> makes <There are propositions> true. Transitivity would yield (3), but the source rejects (3).
text: Truthmaking is non-transitive: Socrates' being white truthmakes the proposition that Socrates is white, and that proposition truthmakes that there are propositions, but Socrates' being white does not truthmake that there are propositions.
